name: Glute and hip stretch
pattern: Static hold: the hip bends and turns out (glutes, deep rotators) or opens wide (inner thigh).
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the other knee, foot flexed.
Thread your hands behind the bottom thigh.

steps.text: Pull the bottom knee toward your chest until you feel the crossed-side glute.
Stay still 15-30 s, head and low back on the floor. Push the crossed knee gently away for more.
Come out slowly, then switch sides.

cues.cue: Bring the knee up toward the opposite shoulder, not just straight to the chest.
cues.why: More hip bend with turn-out and a little cross-body pull lengthened the piriformis 30-40% more than the usual positions.

cues.cue: Flex the crossed foot, toes up.
cues.why: It holds the shin steady and protects the knee from twisting.

cues.cue: Back long; in seated versions lean from the hips.
cues.why: Rounding moves the stretch into the low back.

cues.cue: Ease in to a mild pull, never pain.
cues.why: Gentle stretches still gain range; stretching into pain did not help and can irritate the muscle.

cues.cue: Hold 15-30 s, 2-4 times, about 60 s in total per side.
cues.why: 30 s holds gave the same gains as 60 s; aim for at least 5 min per muscle each week, most days.

cues.cue: Best after training. Before, keep it under 60 s per muscle and finish with a dynamic warm-up.
cues.why: Short holds cost almost no strength or power; long holds (60 s or more) do. Stretching does not speed recovery.

breathing: Breathe slowly and normally. Ease a little deeper as you breathe out.

tempo.note: Ease in for about 3 s, hold 15-30 s, ease out. Repeat 2-4 times each side.

mistakes.name: Rounding the back
mistakes.looks: In seated and pigeon versions you curl forward from the spine.
mistakes.fix: Chest up, hinge at the hips; go less deep.
mistakes.why: The low back takes the stretch instead of the hip.

mistakes.name: Forcing the knee
mistakes.looks: You push the crossed knee down hard or the front knee twists in pigeon.
mistakes.fix: Flex the foot, back off, let the hip open slowly.
mistakes.why: The twist goes to the knee, not the hip.

mistakes.name: Bouncing
mistakes.looks: You bob in and out of the stretch instead of holding still.
mistakes.fix: Ease in slowly, then stay still and let it relax.
mistakes.why: Bouncing triggers the muscle to tighten back and can strain it.

mistakes.name: Holding your breath
mistakes.looks: You tense up: shoulders creep up, jaw tight, breath held.
mistakes.fix: Breathe slowly; let each breath out take you a little deeper.
mistakes.why: Tension fights the stretch; relaxed breathing lets the muscle let go.

safety: Knee pain in pigeon or figure-four: use the lying version and keep the foot flexed.
Groin strain: keep inner-thigh stretches very gentle.
Hip replacement: ask your surgeon before deep bending and turning-in stretches.

variants.change: Seated figure-four on a chair: ankle on the opposite knee, lean forward with a flat back.
Partner moves the knee toward the opposite shoulder; you relax and say when to stop.
Contract-relax: push gently against the stretch for 3-6 s, relax, then ease deeper. Similar range gains to static holds; also best after training.
A partner moves the limb. Go slowly and say when you feel a mild pull; the partner holds there, never pushes into pain.
Moving version: controlled swings through the range, 8-12 reps. Better before training than long holds.

subtypes.name: Pigeon stretch
subtypes.change: Front shin across the mat, back leg long behind; walk the hands forward with a long back.

subtypes.name: 90/90 hip stretch
subtypes.change: Sit with both knees bent 90°, front shin across, back shin to the side; lean over the front shin.

subtypes.name: Knee to chest
subtypes.match: knee to chest|knees to chest|keens to chest|hug|foot to chest|cross over knee|crossover|leg tuck
subtypes.change: On your back, hug one or both knees toward the chest; head and hips down.

subtypes.name: Frog stretch
subtypes.change: On forearms and knees, knees wide, shins parallel; ease the hips back.

subtypes.name: Butterfly stretch
subtypes.change: Sit tall, soles together, knees out; lean forward from the hips.

subtypes.name: Deep squat hold
subtypes.change: Feet a bit wider than hips, sink into a full squat, heels down, elbows pushing the knees out.

subtypes.name: Wide-leg straddle
subtypes.match: sitting wide|seated wide|straddle|sitting sumo|knee flexor and hip adductor|side split|against the wall
subtypes.change: Legs straight and wide (seated, or lying with legs up a wall); lean forward from the hips.

subtypes.name: Side lunge adductor stretch
subtypes.change: Feet wide, bend one knee and shift to it; the straight leg's inner thigh stretches. Toes forward.

subtypes.name: Outer hip stretch
subtypes.match: outer|abductor|iliotibial|leg cross|hip adduction stretch|oblique glute|abduction with flexion
subtypes.change: Cross one leg behind the other and push that hip out to the side, leaning the trunk away.

keyframes.note: trunk side-bent 20° to the left (no joint key yet; proposed trunkRot/trunkSide)

subtypes.name: Lying figure-four
subtypes.change: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee; pull the bottom thigh in.

subtypes.name: Seated glute stretch
subtypes.change: Sit tall, ankle on the opposite knee or hug the knee to the opposite shoulder; lean forward from the hips.

metrics.label: Movement during hold
metrics.good: < 3° once you are in the stretch

motion.basis: Piriformis position (115-120° flexion, 40-50° external rotation, 25-30° adduction) from gulledge2014, a cadaver study; the seated keyframe uses it. Other angles are estimates from the usual stretch positions. Side bend in the outer-hip subtype has no joint key yet and is written in note.
